title: turritis arvensis
intro: Turritis arvensis, commonly known as Field Cress or Land Cress, is a biennial or annual plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Turritis arvensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
